Mining Salvage Cargo Field Guide
Data verified on LIVE Build: Alpha 4.10.1

1. Resource Signature Basics
A resource signature is the scan return you get from a mining scanner or radar sweep before committing to a rock. Strong resource signature readings correlate with higher-yield ore composition, but overlapping signals in dense fields blur individual signature readings and require closer passes to separate.

CLUSTER MULTIPLIER NOTES
Asteroid clusters near jump points receive a cluster multiplier bonus applied to the base extraction yield. A high cluster multiplier makes a modest resource signature worth prospecting even when composition looks average.

2. Cargo Handling
Once ore is extracted, cargo pods fill according to a fixed capacity. Compressed cargo grids reduce the volume-per-unit cost but modestly limit total tonnage compared to raw cargo grids.

3. Salvage Yield Notes
Salvage yield depends on hull integrity remaining at time of scrapping, and inventory refresh ticks at the salvage yard determine how quickly bought material re-lists for resale.
